originalSource:
rem Totient Chains
rem https://projecteuler.net/problem=214
rem Add up the primes below Limit whose
rem totient chain p, phi(p),
rem phi(phi(p)), ... down to 1 has Len
rem terms

use numbers
use sequences
use io
use cli

option Limit integer = 40000000
option Len integer = 25
option Block integer = 1000000

rem Let L(n) = 1 + L(phi(n)) be the
rem number of terms. For a prime p, L(p)
rem = 2 + L(phi(p - 1)) and phi(p - 1)
rem is at most Limit / 2, so only L at
rem even numbers up to Limit / 2 is
rem kept: in Lt[n / 2], filled as phi
rem comes from a sieve one block of
rem numbers at a time.
Root = Limit isqrt + 1
Ps = primes till Root array
Half = Limit // 2
Lt = array shape (Half // 2 + 2) fill 0
Lt 0 = 1
Total = 0
Step = Block - 1
for Lo in 1 to (Limit - 1) by Step
  Hi = (Lo + Block) min (Limit)
  Phi = array shape (Hi - Lo + 1) fill 0
  Rem = array shape (Hi - Lo + 1) fill 0
  for K in 0 to (Hi - Lo)
    Phi K = Lo + K
    Rem K = Lo + K
  end
  for Q in Ps
    From = (Lo + Q - 1) // Q * Q
    for N in From to Hi by Q
      Ix = N - Lo
      Phi Ix -= Phi Ix // Q
      for
        if Rem Ix mod Q not equal 0
          break
        end
        Rem Ix //= Q
      end
    end
  end
  for K in 0 to (Hi - Lo)
    if Rem K greater 1
      Phi K -= Phi K // Rem K
    end
  end
  for K in 1 to (Hi - Lo - 1)
    N = Lo + K
    Even = N mod 2 equal 0
    if Even and N at most Half
      Lt (N // 2) = 1 + Lt (Phi K // 2)
    end
    if Phi K equal N - 1 and N greater 2
      Pm = Phi (K - 1)
      Steps = 2 + Lt (Pm // 2)
      if Steps equal Len
        Total += N
      end
    end
  end
end
Answer = Total
Answer print
